{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 (sentinel value)
valid_rows = df[df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending), then drop duplicates
valid_rows = valid_rows.sort_values(by=["patient_id", "sample_seq"], ascending=[True, False])
deduplicated_df = valid_rows.drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Step 3: Correct assay_batch B values: convert from µg/L to ng/mL (divide by 10)
deduplicated_df["biomarker_final_corrected"] = deduplicated_df["biomarker_final"].copy()
deduplicated_df.loc[deduplicated_df["assay_batch"] == "B", "biomarker_final_corrected"] /= 10

# Step 4: Compute mean of corrected biomarker_final across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = deduplicated_df["biomarker_final_corrected"].mean()

# Output results
print(f'Number of valid rows after filtering biomarker_baseline != -999: {valid_rows.shape[0]}')
print(f'Number of patients after deduplication: {deduplicated_df.shape[0]}')
print(f'Corrected mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final:.2f}')"}
